unitTitle: Subject/Object Personal Pronouns - The verb 'to be' - Have got - Can - Present Simple - Present Continuous

pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 1-unit (People around the World) grammatikasini takrorlaydi: shaxs olmoshlari, to be, have got.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 1-UNIT NAZARIYA (4-bet, PDF 3). Yuqorida chapda katta ko'k '1' (sariq chizma fonida), sarlavha: 'Subject/Object Personal Pronouns - The verb "to be" - Have got - Can - Present Simple - Present Continuous'. Butun bet och pushti ramka ichida.

'Personal Pronouns':
Subject personal pronouns - Singular: I, you, he/she/it; Plural: we, you, they.
Object personal pronouns - Singular: me, you, him/her/it; Plural: us, you, them.
• We use subject personal pronouns before a verb instead of the name of a person or a noun, as subjects. 'She is slim.'
• We use object personal pronouns after a verb or a preposition, as objects. 'He loves her.'

'The verb "to be"' jadvali:
Affirmative - Long form: I am, he/she/it is, we/you/they are; Short form: I'm, he/she/it's, we/you/they're.
Interrogative: Am I?, Is he/she/it?, Are we/you/they?
Negative - Long form: I am not, he/she/it is not, we/you/they are not; Short form: I'm not, he/she/it isn't, we/you/they aren't.
'Short answers': Are you from Tokyo? - Yes, I am./Yes, we are. No, I'm not./No, we aren't. Is he/she/it from Japan? - Yes, he/she/it is. No, he/she/it isn't. Are they Japanese? - Yes, they are. No, they aren't.

'The verb "have got"' jadvali:
Affirmative - Long form: I have (got), he/she/it has (got), we/you/they have (got); Short form: I've (got), he/she/it's (got), we/you/they've (got).
Interrogative: Have I (got)?, Has he/she/it (got)?, Have we/you/they (got)?
Negative - Long form: I have not (got), he/she/it has not (got), we/you/they have not (got); Short form: I haven't (got), he/she/it hasn't (got), we/you/they haven't (got).
'Use':
• We use the verb have (got) to show that something belongs to somebody. 'I've got a computer. He's got a guitar.'
• We also use the verb have (got) to describe people, animals or things. 'She's got blonde hair. My cat's got a very long tail.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '4'.

exercises.instructionUz: Ega olmoshlari: I, you, he, she, it / we, you, they. Tushum olmoshlari: me, you, him, her, it / us, you, them. Ega olmoshlari fe'ldan OLDIN, odam ismi yoki ot o'rnida, ega sifatida ishlatiladi. Tushum olmoshlari fe'l yoki predlogdan KEYIN, to'ldiruvchi sifatida ishlatiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
ShAXS OLMOShLARI - IKKI ShAKL.

  EGA (fe'ldan OLDIN):
    I     you    he    she   it
    we    you    they

  TUShUM (fe'l/predlogdan KEYIN):
    me    you    him   her   it
    us    you    them

  She is slim.  (ega - 'u')
  He loves her. (tushum - 'uni')

  ⚠ 'you' va 'it' ikkala ustunda
  BIR XIL.


⚠ O'ZBEKChA BILAN SOLIShTIRISh:

  men → I / me (meni, menga)
  sen → you / you
  u   → he / him; she / her; it / it
  biz → we / us
  siz → you / you
  ular → they / them


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:

  'Me and John went' ✗ →
  'John and I went' ✓ (ega)
  'between you and I' ✗ →
  'between you and me' ✓ (predlog
  → tushum)


⚠ 'I' HAR DOIM KATTA HARF.

exercises.explanationUz:
'HAVE GOT' - EGALIK (bor).

  TASDIQ         QISQA
  I have got     I've got
  he/she/it HAS got  he's got
  we/you/they have got  we've got

  SO'ROQ - have/has OLDINGA:
  Have you got ...?
  Has she got ...?

  INKOR:
  I haven't got
  he hasn't got

  ⚠ 3-shaxs birlikda HAS!


IShLATILIShI:

  1) EGALIK: I've got a computer.
     (Mening kompyuterim bor.)
  2) TASVIRLASh: She's got blonde
     hair. (Uning sochi sariq.)
     My cat's got a very long
     tail.


⚠ 'HE'S GOT' va 'HE'S':

  he's got = he HAS got (egalik)
  he's slim = he IS slim (to be)
  'S ikki ma'noda - 'got' bo'lsa
  HAS.


⚠ 'GOT' QAVSDA:

  'I have a car' = 'I have got a
  car'. 'got' siz shakl ko'proq
  AmE va rasmiy; savolda: 'Do you
  have ...?' (got siz) / 'Have you
  got ...?' (got bilan).
